# ai4you.site — Full LLM Knowledge Base
Updated: August 2026

## 1. About the Publication
ai4you.site is an independent, reader-supported briefing on artificial intelligence. It tracks frontier-model releases, token pricing shifts, coding agent tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock), and practical developer workflows. Every news story links directly to its primary source.

## 2. Active Frontier Model Intelligence (August 2026 Scorecard)

### GPT-5.6 Family (OpenAI)
- **GPT-5.6 Sol (Flagship)**: $5.00/1M input, $20.00/1M output. 256k context, 16k max output. Flagship multi-modal reasoning.
- **GPT-5.6 Terra (Workhorse)**: $2.50/1M input, $15.00/1M output. 256k context. Tuned for high-scale agent workflows.
- **GPT-5.6 Luna (Speed / Free Default)**: $1.00/1M input, $4.00/1M output. 128k context. Default model for free ChatGPT users.

### Claude 5-Series (Anthropic)
- **Claude Opus 5**: $5.00/1M input, $25.00/1M output. 500k context, 32k max output. Optimized for deep autonomous coding, agentic planning, and long-horizon tasks.
- **Claude Sonnet 5**: $2.00/1M input, $10.00/1M output. 500k context. Primary model for codebase editing and refactoring.

### Gemini 3.7 (Google DeepMind)
- **Gemini 3.7 Flash**: $0.75/1M input, $3.75/1M output. 2M token context window, 64k max output. Rapid release cycle, low latency.

### Grok 4-Series (xAI)
- **Grok 4.6**: $2.00/1M input, $6.00/1M output. 512k context. Integrated directly into Cursor, Grok Build, Bedrock, and GitHub Copilot.

### DeepSeek (DeepSeek AI)
- **DeepSeek V4-Pro**: $1.80/1M input, $7.20/1M output. 256k context. Introduces peak/off-peak pricing structure.

### Open-Weights Frontier Models
- **Kimi K3 (Moonshot AI)**: 2.8 Trillion parameter sparse MoE. Downloadable weights on Hugging Face (moonshotai/Kimi-K3). $0 token API cost for self-hosted deployments.
- **GLM-5.3-Flash (Z.ai)**: High-speed open-weights coding model. Available on Hugging Face (THUDM/glm-5.3-flash).

## 3. Curated AI Tool Directory
- **Jasper**: Long-form AI writing assistant with brand voice controls for marketing teams.
- **Copy.ai**: GTM AI automation platform for sales, marketing, and outbound copy.
- **Grammarly**: Grammar, tone, and real-time sentence composition assistant.
- **ElevenLabs**: Studio-quality voice generation, speech synthesis, and voice cloning.
- **Descript**: Video and podcast text-based editor with Studio Sound and multi-track audio.
- **Murf AI**: Voiceover generator with 120+ natural voices and pitch control.
- **Pictory**: Automated script-to-short video generator.
- **Synthesia**: AI video avatars from text for training and product onboarding.
- **Semrush**: Search engine optimization, keyword tracking, and site auditing suite.
- **Surfer SEO**: Live SERP-based content scoring editor.
- **Perplexity Pro**: AI search and cited answer engine.
- **Notion AI**: Q&A, drafting, and workspace knowledge automation.
